newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: PTT Serbia, Alcatel sign $40 mln deal-paper.
newsitem.headline: PTT Serbia, Alcatel sign $40 mln deal-paper.

text.p: Serbia's postal company PTT and Alcatel-Cit of France signed on Wednesday a two-year 220 million French franc ($40 million) deal, Belgrade daily Politika reported on Thursday.
Under the new agreement, Alcatel will provide Serbia with digital automatic telephone exchanges with a total capacity of 300,000 new telephone lines over a two-year period.
Alcatel will provide exchanges with a capacity of 150,000 lines this year and the same number of lines next year, PTT Serbia general manager Milorad Jaksic was quoted by the Politika as saying.

In a bid to upgrade its phone system which deteriorated during the 3 1/2 years of sanctions and neglect, Serbia plans to install three million new lines by 2005 and double the number of lines to 40 per 100 inhabitants.
